sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# After LEFT x8: green (19,18)-(22,21), blue (19,24)-(22,27), red (13,42)-(16,45)
# Path retracted to col 43
# 
# Try moving UP now that path is shorter - maybe blocks were blocking movement
result = action(['UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(row for row, col in b)
        r_max = max(row for row, col in b)
        print(f"Player: ({r_min},{min(col for _,col in b)})-({r_max},{max(col for _,col in b)})")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 16 and n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N']:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(row for row, col in b)
        if r_min < 50:
            c_min = min(col for _,col in b)
            c_max = max(col for _,col in b)
            r_max = max(row for row,col in b)
            print(f"{n['color']}: ({r_min},{c_min})-({r_max},{c_max})")
print("board_changed:", result.get('board_changed'))
print("gameplay_changed:", result.get('gameplay_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
